meta.description: Synthesised drum kits + sequencer patterns for the Anvil drum engine: 32 complete kits across the 16-slot kit page (kick, snare, rim, clap, closed/open hats, three toms, crash, ride) and 32 kick/hat grooves with swing 60-70, accents, probability, ratchets, conditions and micro-timing. Own-authored clean-room synthesis; no samples.
